ownership.independence_note: Production diff reviewed by a non-author. The four fencing tests are reviewer's own baseline tests, not an independently authored test oracle. Existing three test files remain unchanged.

read_scope.scope: Complete tracked production diff; current snapshot reader/parser/migration/reservation functions; prior fixed-baseline public prepare, receipt validation, budget policy and consumers inspected in preceding read-only analysis.
Namespace marker, acquire, exact owner witness, release and complete context-manager exception handling.
Fixed baseline legacy lock age takeover and blind unlock; no changes made by this patch.
Complete four-case test and fixture; actual public entry/descriptor reachability and no false-positive all-refused control.

checks.result: O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK, regular single-link descriptor, observed-size plus extra-byte read, before/after fstat and named lstat-equivalent identity comparison prevent accepting a changed or redirected observed ledger. Missing initial ledger remains a supported state; no new total-history size cap is claimed.

Existing prefix has a stable snapshot; actual append-open identity must equal that witness. Missing ledger uses O_CREAT|O_EXCL. Appended descriptor state is compared to fresh named readback, and read bytes must equal exact previous raw prefix plus exact newly encoded line.

The final logical read also must equal preceding records plus the proposed record; owner is rechecked. Short, overreported, empty/no-op, or uncertain write/fsync/close/readback cannot return an environment.

The existing legacy project migration remains create-only and preserves prior records. Read-only validation precedes migration. Uncertain migration/append is converted to SourceLockInDoubt inside the ownership context; no truncate, retry replacement, or refund is introduced. Existing pre-Popen provenance publication failure still retains its reserved exposure.

Return from the with body still executes context release before returning to public prepare. A release error cannot grant a nonce. SourceLockInDoubt is converted to BenchmarkContractError only outside the context so in-doubt writes retain the owner where that context protocol permits.

Do not infer that every release error leaves the owner directory present: the existing release can fail on parent fsync after unlink/rmdir. This review claims no returned launch authority on such failure, not universal directory retention.

Old red test reaches actual append-open with a live owner thread; only its private time metadata+mtime are changed, preserving actual host/PID. It is a controlled metadata/age fault, not natural aging. Fix may refuse both after damage; independent fresh-lock case requires a real successful reservation. Silent test positively requires the actual ledger descriptor be intercepted and its bytes remain zero. These are not missing-API tests.

Max-evaluation policy, no-refund retry behavior, project-scoped ledger placement, ordinal/hash/provenance consumers and legacy exposure-reset refusal remain unchanged in scope. No generic fs lock modification or new compute/resource-budget ledger.

limitations: Fault injection uses task-private files and two joined CPU threads; no evaluator, real GPU, provider, or child workload is run.
Observed-file identity checks are not an atomic snapshot of the whole project, a cross-host sandbox, or proof against arbitrary external deletion of all evidence.
No automatic refund, CPU/GPU-second allocation budget, fairness policy, historical cleanup, or total-ledger memory limit is introduced.
Existing SourceLock implementation was reused unchanged; this review does not certify all filesystem failure modes.
66-test run overlaps parent and later suites and must not be added as unique cases.
